top_findings.title: No head-to-head tool between two named teams
top_findings.evidence: main.go:20-21 registers only search_matches, team_stats, search_players, standings, statistics; server.go:144-182 CallTool has no head_to_head case; grep for head-to-head/h2h/opponent in *.go returns nothing. The spec requires it (brazilian-soccer-mcp-guide.md:253 'Head-to-head records', :332 'Can compare teams head-to-head'). search_matches only takes home+away in one orientation and team_stats takes one team, so aggregated H2H W/L/D between two clubs is not obtainable.
top_findings.suggestion: Add a head_to_head(team_a, team_b, season?, competition?) tool that aggregates W/L/D and goals across both home/away orientations.

top_findings.title: MCP tool inputSchemas omit properties, so schema-driven clients can't discover season/competition/team params
top_findings.evidence: main.go:20-21 declares every tool's inputSchema as {"type":"object"} with no "properties" (only "required":["season"] on standings). The factual gate builds its call args from the tool schema (factual_accuracy.py:218-240 _standings_args); with no properties it cannot find the season/competition keys and falls back to standings({}). Empirically that yields season=0/competition="" -> an all-time, all-competition aggregate: 659 rows, Flamengo all-time 1085 matches, 22 distinct Atletico/Athletico rows. This is why factual_accuracy=0.0. Called correctly (standings season=2019 competition=Brasileirao) the server returns the exact right table.
top_findings.suggestion: Declare properties (season:int, competition:string, team/home/away/etc.) in each tool's inputSchema so clients and the gate can pass arguments.

second_opinion.R9_verdict: REFUTED — Flamengo is produced correctly (2019 Brasileirao: 38 played, 28-6-4, 90 pts); 'no Flamengo row' is a gate false-negative (blind probe + pretty-JSON line parser)
second_opinion.atletico_dup_verdict: MISATTRIBUTED — 2019 Brasileirao yields exactly 2 Atletico rows; the 22 is the gate's all-time/all-competition unfiltered aggregate
second_opinion.root_cause_factual_0: tool inputSchemas omit properties, so the gate calls standings() with no season/competition
